description: Governs employee health data processing for fitness-for-work assessments, occupational health surveillance, COVID testing legacy programmes, and absence management. Applies Art. 9(2)(b) employment obligations and Art. 9(2)(h) health professional exceptions. Covers data minimisation, occupational health provider relationships, and return-to-work procedures.
